content.title: Mark Speakman Resigns from Opposition Leadership
content.caption: Former New South Wales opposition leader Mark Speakman announces his resignation from the leadership of the Liberal Party.

slides.heading: Mark Speakman Resigns from Opposition Leadership
slides.text: Former New South Wales opposition leader Mark Speakman announces his resignation from the leadership of the Liberal Party.

slides.heading: Resignation Announcement
slides.text: Mark Speakman resigns from the leadership of the Liberal Party, ending speculation about his future.

slides.heading: Background
slides.text: Mark Speakman served as the opposition leader and attorney general in New South Wales, known for his commitment to multiculturalism.
